SeatDash Runner & Filler Training

Fans order food to their seat. Here’s your part.

  1. The fan ordersfrom their seat
  2. The filler packs itat the stand
  3. The runner deliversto the seat

Swipe or tap → to start

Everyone2 / 14

Staff controls

Tap the ☰ menu on your Runner/Filler card to open this. Turn on Order Notifications, read Messages, Take a break, and switch between Runner and Filler.

Runner3 / 14

Waiting at the stand

Keep this screen open. It shows how many orders are waiting and your place in line. Your next order comes to you, so there’s nothing to grab.

Everyone4 / 14

Taking a break

Open the menu and tap Take a break so no orders come to you. When you return, tap I’m back — send me orders.

Filler5 / 14

A new order arrives

New orders show up on their own. Pack exactly what’s listed, then tap FILLED — Send to Runner. If your stand can’t make it, tap Can’t fill: send to another stand.

Filler6 / 14

On the shelf

Put the bag on the shelf. The On Shelf bar at the top shows the order waiting for a runner, and your screen goes back to waiting for the next one.

Runner7 / 14

A delivery is yours

Grab the bag with the number shown, then swipe I have #… to head out.

Runner8 / 14

On the way

Go to the side, section, row and seat shown. On cash orders, the yellow box shows what the fan is paying with and the change to hand back.

Runner9 / 14

The Beacon button

Can’t spot the fan? Tap Beacon On. Their phone lights up in the same color as your button, so look for it in the stands. You can send it up to 3 times.

Fan viewMockup10 / 14

What the fan sees

If the fan has their order page open, it fills with the beacon color and flashes, showing the last 3 digits of the order number. Look for a phone glowing your button’s color.

Runner11 / 14

Delivered

Hand over the order and swipe DELIVERED. On cash orders, check the cash given and change due, then tap Confirm Delivered. Problem? Tap Something’s Wrong.

Runner12 / 14

Hurry back

Walk back to the stand, then swipe I’m back at the stand. That puts you back in line for the next order.

Fan view13 / 14

Where the seat comes from

At checkout, fans pick their section, row and seat and can tap their spot on the stadium map. That’s the seat info you see on your screen.

Everyone14 / 14

Before you go

  • ☀Keep the screen on. Leave SeatDash open on your phone the whole game. That’s how orders reach you.
  • 🔔Keep notifications on. Tap Enable alerts or Enable Order Notifications so you hear new orders.
  • 💬Something odd? Use Message on the order, or check Messages in the menu, instead of guessing.

You’re ready. Thanks for helping out!
